name: Cowork
description: Claude Cowork is the knowledge-work agent mode in the Claude desktop app (macOS/Windows). It connects to local files and 15+ connectors (Google Workspace, Slack, DocuSign, Excel, PowerPoint, Chrome, and premium data sources like FactSet, MSCI, S&P Global, and Harvey) to run multi-step knowledge-work tasks end to end — organizing files, building spreadsheets, preparing reports — including scheduled and recurring jobs. Powered by Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6. It is the non-coding sibling to Claude Code.

writing-chat.summary: Cowork is an agent mode in the Claude desktop app where users describe a knowledge-work goal in chat; Cowork proposes a plan, executes it end to end, and allows mid-task redirection.

subFeatures.name: Desktop App Agent Chat
subFeatures.description: Conversational interface in the Claude desktop app (macOS/Windows) where users brief Cowork on a task; users switch between Chat, Code, and Cowork tabs

subFeatures.name: Plan-Then-Execute Tasks
subFeatures.description: Cowork shows a plan for a multi-step knowledge-work task, then executes it end to end, building spreadsheets, preparing reports, and organizing files

subFeatures.name: Mid-Task Redirection
subFeatures.description: Users can steer or correct Cowork while a task is running, adjusting scope or approach without restarting

limitations: Runs in the Claude desktop app (macOS/Windows), not a web interface
Available only on paid Claude plans (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise)
Focused on knowledge work, not software coding (use Claude Code for coding)

pricingTiers.details: Cowork agent mode included, drawing on the subscription's usage pool
Higher usage limits for intensive knowledge-work tasks
Admin controls, usage visibility, and private plugin marketplaces

versionHistory.changes: Knowledge-work agent mode launched in research preview in the Claude desktop app
12 new connectors, native Excel/PowerPoint research preview, private plugin marketplaces, and admin controls

research.summary: Cowork performs multi-step research as part of knowledge-work tasks — navigating Chrome, pulling from connected data sources (FactSet, MSCI, S&P Global), and synthesizing findings into reports.

subFeatures.name: Web and Chrome Research
subFeatures.description: Navigates Chrome to gather information from the web as part of a knowledge-work task

subFeatures.name: Connected Data Sources
subFeatures.description: Pulls from premium connectors such as FactSet, MSCI, S&P Global, and Harvey to research financial, market, and legal information

subFeatures.name: Report Synthesis
subFeatures.description: Synthesizes research into prepared reports and spreadsheets as task deliverables

limitations: Premium data connectors (FactSet, MSCI, S&P Global, Harvey) require the organization's own subscription and are typically Enterprise-gated
Cannot access authenticated or paywalled content without a configured connector
Research is scoped to the active knowledge-work task

pricingTiers.details: Web and Chrome research included; standard connectors
Premium data connectors subject to the organization's own licensing

versionHistory.changes: Added FactSet, MSCI, S&P Global, Harvey, Similarweb, and other research connectors
Web and Chrome research within agent tasks

file-analysis.summary: Cowork reads and analyzes local files and folders on the user's machine, plus files from connected services, using them as inputs for multi-step knowledge-work tasks.

subFeatures.name: Local File and Folder Access
subFeatures.description: Reads local files and folders on the user's machine to analyze, organize, and transform their contents

subFeatures.name: Spreadsheet and Document Analysis
subFeatures.description: Parses spreadsheets and documents (including via native Excel/PowerPoint) to extract, summarize, and restructure data

subFeatures.name: Connector-Sourced Files
subFeatures.description: Analyzes files retrieved from connected services such as Google Drive and DocuSign

limitations: Native Excel/PowerPoint handling is in research preview
Local file access is governed by desktop-app permissions
Analysis quality depends on the underlying Claude model

pricingTiers.details: Local file and connector-sourced file analysis included

versionHistory.changes: Native Excel/PowerPoint research preview for reading and producing files
Local file and folder analysis within agent tasks

document-creation.summary: Cowork produces real knowledge-work deliverables — spreadsheets, presentations, and reports — handing off native .xlsx and .pptx files rather than only exporting to them.

subFeatures.name: Native Excel and PowerPoint Output
subFeatures.description: Builds and hands off real .xlsx and .pptx files (research preview), not just text exports

subFeatures.name: Report and Spreadsheet Preparation
subFeatures.description: Prepares reports, fills spreadsheets, and assembles deliverables as the output of a multi-step task

limitations: Native Excel/PowerPoint output is in research preview
Document creation is part of a knowledge-work task, not a standalone editor
No collaborative real-time document editing between users

pricingTiers.details: Report, spreadsheet, and presentation creation included

versionHistory.changes: Native Excel/PowerPoint file creation in research preview
Spreadsheet and report generation within agent tasks

image-generation.summary: Cowork does not generate images. It is a knowledge-work agent focused on files, spreadsheets, reports, and connected data.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Image generation is not part of Cowork's knowledge-work feature set

limitations: No image generation capability
No integration with image generation APIs
Cannot create visual assets or graphics

prototyping.summary: Cowork is not a coding or app-prototyping tool. It is the knowledge-work agent mode; software prototyping and coding belong to Claude Code.

subFeatures.name: Not a Coding Tool
subFeatures.description: Cowork focuses on knowledge work (files, spreadsheets, reports, connectors); use Claude Code for software prototyping and coding

personalization.summary: Cowork is tailored through task instructions and the set of connected services and plugins available to the agent, with enterprise admins able to curate approved connectors and agents.

subFeatures.name: Task Instructions

subFeatures.name: Connector and Plugin Configuration

limitations: Premium connectors require the organization's own licensing
Enterprise curation and admin controls govern what agents may access

pricingTiers.details: Task instructions and standard connector configuration
Private plugin marketplaces and admin-curated connector catalogues

persistent-context.summary: Cowork sustains work over time through scheduled and recurring jobs that keep running on Anthropic-managed infrastructure, plus persistent connections to the user's files and connected services.

subFeatures.name: Scheduled and Recurring Jobs
subFeatures.description: Daily, weekly, or monthly knowledge-work jobs that keep running on Anthropic-managed infrastructure

subFeatures.name: Persistent Connectors
subFeatures.description: Standing connections to local files and connected services (Google Workspace, Slack, DocuSign, and more) reused across tasks

limitations: Scheduled jobs run on Anthropic-managed infrastructure subject to plan limits
Context is scoped to the connected services and files the agent is granted
Per-task memory is bounded by the model context window

pricingTiers.details: Scheduled/recurring jobs and persistent connectors included

versionHistory.changes: Expanded connector ecosystem for persistent data access
